Cardiomegaly: absent
Atelectasis: present
Lung Lesion: present
Pleural Effusion: absent
Fracture: present

The imaging reports identify several specific findings including lung opacity, atelectasis, lung lesions, and fractures, while cardiomegaly and pleural effusion are explicitly noted as absent. A nodular density was found in the lung, and another report confirmed the presence of healing rib fractures.

Key points:
- A 2.1 cm nodular density was observed in the anterior costophrenic area, which may represent a pulmonary nodule or lung lesion.
- Focal atelectasis or scarring was identified within the lingula of the lung.
- Multiple bilateral rib fractures with callus formation were noted, indicating healing fractures.
- Heart size was consistently reported as normal or within normal limits across all examinations.
- Pleural effusions and pneumothorax were not present in any of the reviewed cases.
